UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" && if [ -d src/.git ]; then git -C src fetch --depth 1 origin \"{{PvPGNRef}}\" && git -C src checkout -f FETCH_HEAD; else rm -rf src && git clone --depth 1 --branch \"{{PvPGNRef}}\" https://github.com/pvpgn/pvpgn-server.git src; fi"

-c "cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}src\" && rm -rf build stage && cmake -G \"Unix Makefiles\" -S . -B build -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D WITH_D2CS=OFF -D WITH_D2DBS=OFF -D WITH_SQLITE3=ON -D WITH_LUA={{BuildLua}} -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}server\" && cmake --build build -j\"$(nproc)\" && DESTDIR=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}src/stage\" cmake --install build"

-c "S=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}src/stage{{$FullBaseDir}}server\"; D=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}server\"; mkdir -p \"$D\" && { cp -rn \"$S/.\" \"$D/\" 2>/dev/null; true; } && install -m 755 \"$S/sbin/bnetd\" \"$D/sbin/bnetd\" && cp -f \"$S/etc/pvpgn/versioncheck.json\" \"$D/etc/pvpgn/versioncheck.json\" && rm -rf \"{{$FullBaseDir}}src/build\" \"{{$FullBaseDir}}src/stage\""
